description: This file defines the ClientNotAvailableException class, a custom exception used in the Orleans runtime to indicate that a client is no longer reachable. It contains multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios, including serialization support.

classes.name: ClientNotAvailableException
classes.description: A sealed custom exception class indicating an unreachable client in Orleans runtime.

methods.name: ClientNotAvailableException(GrainId clientId)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating no activation exists for the specified client id.

methods.name: ClientNotAvailableException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a custom message.

methods.name: ClientNotAvailableException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message and an inner exception for chaining.

methods.name: ClientNotAvailableException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
methods.description: Private constructor used for deserialization, marked obsolete.
